title: Influence cutoff and noise parameters
statement: Let $\lambda,I,\varepsilon\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $0<\lambda\le 1/2$, $I>0$, and $\varepsilon>0$, and let $k\in\mathbb N$. Set $\rho=\sqrt{\lambda}/3$ and $\tau=(\varepsilon/(2I))^2\rho^{2k}$. Then $0<\rho\le 1$, $\tau>0$, $\sqrt{\tau}\,I=(\varepsilon/2)\rho^k$, and $I/\tau=(4I^3/\varepsilon^2)(9/\lambda)^k$.
replaced: Let $0<\lambda\le1/2$, $I,\varepsilon>0$, and $k\in\mathbb N$. Put $\rho=\sqrt\lambda/3$ and $\tau=(\varepsilon/(2I))^2\rho^{2k}$; then $0<\rho\le1$, $\tau>0$, $\sqrt\tau I=(\varepsilon/2)\rho^k$, and $I/\tau=(4I^3/\varepsilon^2)(9/\lambda)^k$.
